en: "Me, Wanelly...{w}I ain't about to abandon ship and run...{w}I told ya to bring the shot, didn't I!!"{w}
note: [JP]: the captain naming themself (could also be read as 'this ship'); rendered as self-reference since the line goes on about abandoning ship.

en: Relics of this ship are drifting about.{w}
note: [JP] = belongings left by the dead; 'relics' used throughout the Wanelly quest.

en: Retrieve them?

[Key Item]
You obtained the Wanelly's Anchor.{w}
As you retrieved the last of the relics,{w}Captain Wanelly appeared!!{w}
"You lot...{w}My shiiip...{w}What're you gonna do with my shiiip..."{w}
Unless you take these relics back, Captain Wanelly will stay trapped at the bottom of the sea forever.{w}{p}You steeled yourselves.{w}
note: Accuracy: subject of [JP] restored as the party (passive dropped).

en: You routed Captain Wanelly.{w}
"My... shiiip...{w}My precious shiiip...{w}The memories... with my crew..."{w}
"Captaaain...{w}It's 'bout time you passed on with us, eh..."{w}
note: [JP]: 'let's go (to death) together'; speaker is a dead crewman (revealed in the name box at 2775).

en: "Y... you... you're..."{w}
"Captaaain...{w}We've come to fetch yaaa..."{w}
"Wait... I can't lose the ship..."{w}
Wanelly Sailor
"Forget the ship...{w}We can always build another one, can't we..."{w}
"Let's all get together... and have a feast, eh...{w}Everybody's... just waitin' on you now, Captain..."{w}
"I see...{w}Everyone... passed on... safe and sound...{w}Then... I no longer..."{w}
note: Trails off; continued in 2782.

en: "This ship... the place everyone comes home to...{w}I don't have to... guard it anymore...{w}I don't have to guard it... all by myself..."{w}
"...I'm sorry...{w}I'm so sorry... my Wanelly...{w}After you looked after me all this time..."{w}
note: [JP] here = the ship, which the captain is addressing (not themself). [editorial] 'my Wanelly' so the address reads as the ship, not the captain's own name.

en: "Thank you... for everything... all this time..."{w}
Captain Wanelly and the crew vanished into the light...{w}
note: [JP] = the captain and companions; the crew has been established in the scene.

en:
[Key Item]
You obtained the Wanelly's Sail.{w}
note: New item name.

en:
[Key Item]
You obtained the Wanelly's Prow.{w}
note: New item name; [JP] = bow/prow.

en:
[Key Item]

en: Beyond the darkness was a giant jellyfish.{w}It was probably the master of the Narmant Trench.{w}
note: [editorial] tense aligned with the past-tense first sentence.

en: Jellyfish
note: New name box.

en: "Aaah... aaaah...!!"{w}

Has it lost its mind?{w}The moment it saw you,
it attacked without warning!!{w}
You routed Shirinmorin.{w}

"Hah... hah...{w}Honestly, you... what a way to treat a lady..."{w}{p}"Well, thanks to that I've come to my senses,
so I'll let it slide this time."{w}{p}"...What?{w}You're asking why I'd lost my mind?"{w}{p}"It's the Holy Foundation, Contrachio.{w}That ominous presence flowing out of there..."{w}{p}"As one of the Four Sages, I ought to be protecting
the land from a presence like that.{w}And yet..."{w}{p}"I wonder why.{w}It felt so... nostalgic...{w}No, that word doesn't come close to what I felt."{w}{p}"...Before I knew it, I had let it in.{w}We Four Sages are greater beings than you.{w}So its influence on us is stronger, too..."{w}{p}"If you're an adventurer, won't you go and uncover
the 'true' nature of the presence
at the Holy Foundation, Contrachio?"{w}
note: [JP] rendered 'let it in' (accepted the presence). [JP] -> 'truly' in single quotes. [editorial] dangling quoted 'truly' after a long subject reworded as the 'true' nature (honto no shotai).

en:
"Peace is boring, but all this commotion
is a bit much, too.{w}You there, do a trick or something to cheer me up."{w}
note: [JP] = put me at ease / lighten the mood.

en: "Oh, what is it?"{w}

You handed Radrecht's letter
to Shirinmorin.{w}
She tore it up and threw it away!!{w}
note: Subject is Shirinmorin (female per glossary).

[JP]♪ rendered 'sweetieee~'. [JP] / [JP] pun kept as 'have the face' / 'with that face'. Radrecht named instead of a pronoun (gender unknown). 'Forever' echoes [JP] across the two pages. [editorial] Radrecht's own form for -chan is 'sweet Shirinmorin' (slice 059).

en: Something strange is lying on the sea floor.{w}
Pick it up?
Mizuchi

"Lady Shirinmorin's gone off the deep end lately.{w}She shut the doors and holed herself up inside.{w}What's gotten into her..."{w}{p}"I'm no good with dark places.{w}If only somebody would go press
the four switches for me..."{w}
note: [JP] -> 'Lady Shirinmorin' (female per glossary, so the honorific convention allows Lady).

en:
"Thank goodness,
Lady Shirinmorin's back to her senses...{w}It was you guys, right? Thanks."{w}
note: [editorial] removed thanks-to-you / thanks echo.

en:
"Lady Shirinmorin's gone.{w}Apparently she's off to protect someone precious to her.{w}It'll be lonely, but it can't be helped."{w}{p}"From now on, we're the ones who'll
liven up Narmant!!"{w}
note: [JP] = someone precious; gender of that person not given, kept 'someone'.

en: "What?! D-don't talk to me right now!{w}Huh? What am I doing?{w}Hm, hmph! Prepare to be amazed!"{w}{p}"I-I'm about to jump off from here!{w}With a lifeline, of course.{w}It's what they call a b-bungee jump!!"{w}
Chief Retainer

note: [JP] -> 'young lord' throughout this scene (the Goblin Prince, male per glossary).

en: "Bungee's canceled!"{w}

"That will not do.{w}The new king's bungee jump is
a tradition of Baroque Fort."{w}
note: [editorial] stiff 'a bungee jump by the new king' smoothed.

en: Ogre Knight
"Hey, Prince!{w}You can handle this much, can't you?"{w}

"Oh, some adventurers, just at the right moment."{w}{p}"Would you all mind going to find the gear
for the bungee jump?{w}A bungee rope, and some sort of cushion, if you please..."{w}

note: [JP] = Zabutoon (glossary).

en: "If you search the whole castle, I'm sure you'll find them.{w}Still, what a strange thing to happen.{w}I prepared so carefully for today..."{w}

"H-hey! You don't have to
look all that hard, okay?{w}Don't you go getting all fired up!?"{w}
note: [editorial] awkward word order.

en:
"Hmph! Even if they get them ready,
I'll just throw them out as many times as it takes!{w}Bungee? Like I'd ever put up with..."{w}{p}"H-hey there!{w}How long have you been standing there?{w}Th-that's sneaky of you... ha ha ha!!"{w}{p}"...Please.{w}Don't go looking for them... I'm begging you!"{w}
note: [JP]... interrupted; kept unfinished. [JP] = 'sneaky / not nice'. [JP] (bowing gesture) -> 'I'm begging you'.

en: "Eeek!?{w}Th-that's the bungee gear!?"{w}
note: [editorial] 'gear' as in 2666 and slice 049.

en:
"Well, well.{w}You've gathered them for us.
Thank you very much."{w}
"Y-you traitooors!!"{w}
note: Aimed at the party, who brought the gear.

en:
"What're you talkin' about.{w}C'mon, hurry up and show us
how cool our new king is."{w}

"Normally, this ceremony is not open to the public.{w}However, since you all lent us a hand,
please do watch before you leave."{w}
"Go home! I hate you!!"{w}
note: [JP] aimed at the party: the retainer has just invited them to watch, and 2691 calls them benefactors.

en: "One mustn't say such rash things to one's benefactors, you know?"{w}
"Hurry up and get ready.{w}Want me to help you?"{w}
"Y-you idiot!{w}Don't touch me! Stay away from me!"{w}

"Then please be quick about it.{w}It's nothing: tie on the bungee rope and hop,
and that's the end of it."{w}
note: [JP] -> 'tie and hop' (the chant that follows).

en: "E-easy for you to say..."{w}
"C'mon, tie and hop! Tie and hop!!{w}Hup, hup, tie and hop! Tie and hop!!"{w}
note: [JP] = festival chant call -> 'Hup, hup'.
[JP] (a perfect cordon around the Prince) -> 'completely surrounded'. [editorial] dangling 'around'.

en: "Eek, eeeek..."{w}
"Tie and hop, come on, tie and hop!{w}Good adventurers, do join in as well!{w}Here we go, tie and hop, hippity hop hop hop!"{w}
note: [JP] -> 'hippity hop hop hop'. [editorial] retainer's polite address (-dono) as 'Good adventurers' (slice 049).

en: Crowd's Voices
note: New name box; follows the 'X's Voice' pattern.

en: Tie and hop, tie and hop, tie and hop,{w}tie-'n'-ho tie-'n'-ho tie-'n'-ho tie and hop{w}tie, tie, tie and hop hop hop hop...{w}
note: No quote brackets in the source; kept unquoted. [JP] (clipped) -> 'tie-'n'-ho'.

en: "D-damn iiit!!{w}I'll do it, I'll do iiit!!"{w}
note: [editorial] elongation spelled like 'iiit' in the same row.

en: "Graaanniiieee"{w}
note: No closing punctuation in the source; kept.

en: "Heh, the young lord always was a granny's boy.{w}...Wait, what!? Y-young lord!!{w}You're supposed to lay the cushion out below first!?"{w}
note: [editorial] impersonal passive with !? read oddly; subject (the young lord) restored.

en: "And the end of the bungee rope!!{w}You haven't tied it to anything yet, have you!?"{w}
"I~~ to~~ tal~~ ly~~ forgot~~!?"{w}
note: Drawn-out wa~su~re~te~ta; five stretched chunks kept with '~~'.

en: "Gwahk!?"{w}
note: [JP] = impact cry.

en: Ogre Below
note: Lead set Ogre Below (10 chars) per the Ogre Below / Goblin Below convention; the earlier Ogre Below's Voice was 18 chars. Pairs with the goblin counterpart in slice 049. Accuracy: checked, speaker (the ogre below) kept.
